title: BTS Arrives in Mexico City — Estadio GNP Seguros Pre-Show Prep Begins Ahead of May 7 Latin American Opener
detail: On May 5, 2026 — Day 4,709 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut — BTS arrives in Mexico City to begin pre-show preparations for the ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg at Estadio GNP Seguros (formerly Estadio Azul). The Mexico City run consists of three concert dates: May 7, May 9, and May 10, 2026 (8:00 PM local time starts). The venue features the ARIRANG tour's signature 360-degree center-stage configuration with four cross-shaped walkways extending outward, ensuring clear sightlines across all sections. Official HYBE merchandise stands opened at the stadium on May 4, drawing lines of early-arriving ARMY from across Mexico, Central America, and the US. Infobae Mexico confirmed merchandise locations, hours, and pricing as BTS-adjacent fan activity began building around the stadium. This marks BTS's return to Mexico City — their first performances there since before the COVID-19 pandemic and military service hiatus. The Latin American leg of the ARIRANG World Tour is one of the most anticipated stops for a fanbase that has consistently ranked Mexico among the top markets for BTS album sales and streaming.

title: 'SWIM' Sixth Consecutive Week on Billboard Hot 100 (No. 32) — ARIRANG Holds No. 5 on Billboard 200 in Sixth Week
detail: Billboard's charts dated May 9, 2026 — released the week of May 5 — confirm 'SWIM' completes its sixth consecutive week on the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 32, maintaining strong presence six weeks after debuting at No. 1. The single has now charted on multiple Billboard surveys simultaneously: Pop Airplay (No. 12), Radio Songs (No. 24), Adult Contemporary (No. 19), Digital Song Sales (No. 16), and Adult Pop Airplay (No. 14). On the Billboard Global 200, 'SWIM' holds at No. 2 for a sixth consecutive week in the top 3 — the longest sustained Global 200 top-tier run by any K-pop act in chart history. The ARIRANG album holds at No. 5 on the Billboard 200 (sixth week in the top tier), while also charting at No. 4 on Top Album Sales, No. 11 on Top Streaming Albums, and No. 5 on Vinyl Albums. The Vinyl Albums position rises 3 spots week-over-week, driven by renewed collector demand during the Mexico City leg. All 13 vocal tracks from ARIRANG have remained on both the Global 200 and Global excl. US charts for six consecutive weeks — a K-pop album record for sustained multi-track global charting. STARNEWS Korea reports these figures as evidence of BTS's 'unbreakable dominance across Billboard's entire chart ecosystem.'

media.caption: 'SWIM' hits sixth consecutive week on Billboard Hot 100 at No. 32; ARIRANG holds No. 5 on Billboard 200 in week six
